title: Presale Inbox
intro: Ten messages about launches and presales, one minute. Hype is everywhere tonight.
Swipe left if it is a scam, right if it is safe. Or tap the buttons.
Careful: some are honest. Do not cry wolf.

cards.text: PRESALE LIVE! Send 0.2 BTC now, get 3x tokens at launch. Only 50 spots left!
cards.why: Send-first presales with a scarcity claim are a classic rug-pull setup.

cards.text: Your scheduled ZLX purchase of €50 completed. See your balance in the app.
cards.why: You set this up yourself, it points to the app and asks for nothing.

cards.text: I know a coin launching tomorrow that will 50x. DM me to get in before everyone.
cards.why: A secret tip from a stranger, pushing you to act before checking.

cards.text: Our token launch is tomorrow. Read the open terms on our official site. We never ask you to send coins first.
cards.why: It points to the official site, gives no hurry and warns against send-first scams.

cards.text: WL spot reserved! Confirm by connecting your wallet: tindro-whitelist.live
cards.why: Connecting a wallet to a surprise link can hand over your coins.

cards.text: Join our private group, 10x calls daily. Entry only €99, ends tonight.
cards.why: A paid group full of guaranteed calls is how pump-and-dump groups make money.

cards.text: New listing notice: a token will be tradable from Monday. This is not investment advice. Read the risks in the app.
cards.why: It informs, asks for nothing and warns about risk.

cards.text: Presale closes in 10 minutes! Send now to wallet 0x2d9…44f. No refunds.
cards.why: A countdown, a raw address and no refunds are all warning signs.

cards.text: Heads up: a fake presale is going round our group. Do not send coins to anyone. 🙂
cards.why: A friend you know, warning you, asking for nothing.

cards.text: Claim your airdrop in 24 hours. Sign in at zelvora-airdrops.co and approve the claim.
cards.why: A look-alike domain, a deadline and a request to approve a claim.

golden_rule: A real launch never makes you send coins first, or hurry, or connect your wallet to a surprise link.

quick_check.q: A message says "Presale closes in 10 minutes, send coins to this address now". What do you do?

options.text: Do not send. Check the project's official site and report the message

quick_check.explain: A countdown plus a raw address is a rug-pull sign. The official site is the only source.
